usage: 蚊 is a noun that refers to the insect mosquito.
You can use 蚊 to talk about an annoying mosquito that bites you.
蚊 can be used in singular and plural contexts, for example, one mosquito or many mosquitoes.
It is common to use 蚊 in expressions warning about mosquitoes or talking about mosquito bites.
蚊 is often paired with words related to pest control or summer weather.
